phase2.firstRun: Codex's FIRST run is a Taylor-only BASELINE, starting when #2201 is nonprod-verified. Every Ventana case is BLOCKED (reason: the Ventana key is not yet bound) -- never PASS, never FAIL.

routeCheck.note: every API path in this plan is a route the server dispatches (ports of eosApiDomainFor and the *_ROUTE constants); the check fails the generator otherwise

expected.ALLOW: permitted (subject to the record-level conditions in `basis`)
expected.DENY: refused (a foreign-company or conditioned record is NONEXISTENT: identical not-found)
expected.SCOPED: permitted only inside the stated scope (sales channel, company, warehouse)
expected.PRESENT: dashboard section present in the persona layout
expected.CONDITIONAL: permitted only on the caller's own assignment
expected.UNDETERMINED: no governed expectation exists: do NOT assert; report observed behaviour (Owner question in docs/uat/07-owner-questions.md)
expected.ALLOW_PREVIEW_ONLY: permitted; UAT may preview but must never commit
